description.value: Boardwalk Fries Burgers Shakes is a Canadian fast-casual chain founded in 1981, built around made-to-order burgers, signature boardwalk-style fries, and creamy milkshakes made with premium Canadian dairy. The Abbotsford location is one of 27+ across Canada, offering cyclists a quick and filling stop with a casual beachside diner atmosphere. The menu extends beyond the classic burger lineup to include veggie burgers, poutine, sweet potato fries, and chicken dishes.
